# .github

## Purpose
Container directory for GitHub Actions CI/CD configuration. Holds no files of its own — everything lives under `workflows/`.

## Subdirectories
| Directory | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| `workflows/` | GitHub Actions workflow definitions — currently just the frontend build/deploy pipeline (see `workflows/AGENTS.md`). |

## For AI Agents

### Working In This Directory
This directory has no content to edit directly; look under `workflows/` for the actual pipeline definitions.
